questionText: Are November-March materially better than June-August for this method?
reason: The seasonal rule is prescriptive - it changes his risk by a factor of three to five - and rests entirely on 'months statistically that I've seen in my trading', with no data shown. Unlike most performance claims in the library this one is **directly testable without a risk model**: count setup frequency and directional outcome by calendar month. See RC-27.
